description: AION 2 game mechanics the Ascent Plan rests on, one record per rule with a status. confirmed: seen in game or settled by Miguel. unconfirmed: guides say it, nobody has tested it yet; every page that rests on it shows a Not confirmed yet tag and the in-game test below. Flip a status here and every screen follows. Every rule carries a provenance block (platform/contracts/provenance.schema.json), never shown on a page; guideViews says which order each macro guide describes. The macro facts themselves (slots, delay, hold, interrupt, key binding) live in progression.json under macro-order; the macro-order rule here points at them so there is one place to edit. A confirmed rule with a value the engine reads (mastery-cap: the Mastery cap and where levels past it come from) keeps that value under value. enchant-rates is confirmed by four guides that agree, one of them read from the global client data; the official item data confirms the caps it rests on (grades.json). The enchant rules (enchant-rates, enchant-pity, enchant-carry, enhance-stones) feed the Gear page's item card and the gear moves; the grade caps they rest on live in grades.json.

records.label: Skill stacks
records.text: Each key holds up to four skills stacked in rows 0 to 3, row 0 nearest the key. Pressing the key checks row 0 first: if that skill is ready it fires, otherwise the game moves up to row 1, 2 and 3 and fires the first one that is ready.
rules: Cooldown skills at the bottom, no-cooldown filler at the top.
A no-cooldown skill below a cooldown skill blocks it: it is always ready, so the key never reaches the skill above.
Heals, defensives, big buffs and charged skills go on their own keys, so you choose when they fire.

provenance.note: Screenshot of his own bar: four rows on a key, row 0 at the bottom, the key fires the lowest ready skill.

records.label: Chain skills
records.text: Using some skills opens a follow-up skill for a short window. The skill tooltip lists the skills that lead into a follow-up.
records.unknown: How the follow-up is pressed and how long the window lasts are not confirmed.
records.test: Use a lead-in skill, then press the follow-up's key at once. Does it fire, and how long is it available?

leadIns.reason: The tooltip names two lead-in skills. They are not captured yet.

provenance.note: The tooltip shows two skills that lead into Ankle Slice.

records.label: How a macro fires
records.text: Guides disagree on how a macro picks its next skill.

options.text: The macro runs its entries in the listed order, 1 then 2 and so on.
The macro works like a stack: it fires the first ready entry from the bottom and skips entries on cooldown.

notes: Adding a stacked key to a macro runs that key's stack.
Holding left click with the macro key makes it cycle faster (guides, not tested).
records.test: Make a macro with A then B, and get A on cooldown. Does B fire, and when A is ready again does the macro go back to A first?

provenance.note: Entries are numbered with a delay between each pair. That shows the window, not which entry fires when one is on cooldown; the test above settles it.

records.label: Mastery cap
records.text: Mastery takes a skill to Lv 11 at most. Levels above 11 come from Daevanion skill nodes (+1 each), gear stat lines and Arcana.

provenance.note: Mastery stops at skill Lv 11. Keen Strike read at Lv 10. Levels above 11 come from Daevanion skill nodes (+1 each), gear stat lines and Arcana, as the class research note (claude/aion2-class-research-6oct2026.md) lists them.

provenance.title: Skills guide: active, passive and stigma

records.label: Enchant success
records.text: Every enchant step up to +10 succeeds. Past +10 the chance is 65% for +11, 50% for +12, 35% for +13, 25% for +14 and 20% for +15. A failure costs the attempt (its stones and Kina), never a level, and never breaks the item.
records.test: Open the Enchant window on an item at +10 and read the success chance it shows for +11.

provenance.title: AION 2 Enhancement: Success Chance and Cost of Every Step to +15 by Grade

records.label: Enchant failure bonus
records.text: Each failed try above +10 adds 5 points to the chance of the next try at that step. A success resets it.
records.test: Fail an enchant above +10, then check whether the chance shown for the same step went up by 5.

provenance.title: AION 2 Enhancement: Success Chance and Cost of Every Step to +15 by Grade

records.label: Enchant level carries over

parts.text: Transfer crafting a crafted item into the next step keeps its enchant level.
Moving a Unique item's enchant level onto another Unique item keeps the level.
parts.test: Before a Unique to Unique transfer, check the preview for the enchant level on the new item.

records.text: A crafted upgrade step keeps the item's enchant level. A Unique to Unique gear transfer may keep it too, not confirmed yet.

records.label: Enhance Stones

value.name: Enhance Stone
from: Dungeon clears, such as Daeva Bio-Research Base and Nightmare Altar

records.text: Enchanting weapons, armour and most accessories uses Enhance Stones and Kina. Amulets and belts use their own scrolls instead.
records.test: In game, open an Enhance Stone's item card and check where it says it comes from.

records.label: Title effects
records.text: Each title has two kinds of effect. The top lines (equipStatList in the official data) work only while the title is set as an equipped effect, one per category. The bottom line (statList) is always on once the title is owned. The title the Daeva shows (profile.titleName) is cosmetic.

parts.text: Equip effect: works only while the title is set as the equipped effect for its category.

provenance.note: Titles not set as an effect show their top lines greyed and their bottom line lit.
